k:懐.mnemonic: Ten (十) keepsakes caught in a net (罒) and tucked inside the garment (衣), right against the heartbeat (忄). That is where you carry the people you miss. Feelings (heart, yearn, miss someone).
k:懐.hint: Keepsakes tucked next to the chest.

k:暦.mnemonic: Under the overhang (厂) hangs a hemp (麻) cord, and each day (日) someone ties one more knot in it to keep count of the year. Calendar (almanac).

k:塾.mnemonic: The child (子) sits on the soil (土) floor, mouth (口) reciting, going round (丸) and round the same lessons long after real school has finished. Cram school (private school).

k:惜.mnemonic: The heartbeat (忄) slows when you think of how things were once upon a time (昔). What a shame that it is all gone. Pity (be sparing of, frugal, stingy).
k:惜.hint: Sighing over the good old days.

k:隅.mnemonic: Where the mound (阝) meets the rice field (田), a creature in a hood (冂) spends the day (日) curled up like a cocoon (厶), leaving one paw print (禸) in the mud of its nook. Corner (nook).
k:隅.hint: Creature curled where mound meets field.

k:疲.mnemonic: Flopped across the sickbed (疒) like an empty pelt (皮), with nothing left inside to hold you up. Exhausted (tire, weary).

k:肥.mnemonic: For a month (月) the farmer stirs the dung heap in a slow swirl (巴). Then he spreads it, and the crops grow fat. Fertilizer (get fat, fertile, manure).

k:浄.mnemonic: A tsunami (氵) of water from the bucket and a stiff broom (ヨ): the cradle (勹) is scrubbed until it is fit for the new baby. Clean (purify, cleanse, exorcise).
k:浄.hint: Scrubbing the cradle for a newborn.

k:偶.mnemonic: The leader (亻) crosses the rice field (田) with his hood (冂) pulled low. Without meaning to, he treads on a cocoon (厶) and lands in a paw print (禸). Accidentally (even number, couple, man & wife).
k:偶.hint: Hooded, not looking where he steps.

k:掌.mnemonic: A sparkle (⺌) of light hovers above your forehead (冖). Open your hand (手) flat and the firefly settles right in the middle of it. Palm of hand (rule, administer, conduct).
k:掌.hint: Firefly landing on an open hand.

k:釣.mnemonic: A gold (金) hook on a long line, and a scoop net ready to cradle (勹) the one small fish that bites. Angling (fish, catch, allure).
k:釣.hint: Golden hook and a scoop net.

k:闇.mnemonic: The gate (門) has swung shut and you can see nothing at all. Only a sound (音) from the other side tells you where you are. Get dark (gloom, disorder).
k:闇.hint: Only noises behind a shut gate.

k:桃.mnemonic: A tree (木) covered in pink blossom is a portent (兆): by summer it will hang heavy with soft, fuzzy fruit. Peach.

k:筒.mnemonic: Cut bamboo (竹) anywhere along its length and you get the same (同) thing every time: a hollow tube. Cylinder (pipe, tube, gun barrel).
k:筒.hint: Every cut gives a hollow tube.

k:偉.mnemonic: A leader (亻) who still wears a plain tanned hide (韋) and digs beside his people. Everyone looks up to him. Admirable (greatness, remarkable, conceited).
k:偉.hint: The chief who digs with everyone.

k:恥.mnemonic: The heart (心) sinks and the ear (耳) burns red: everybody heard what you did. Shame (dishonor).

k:斜.mnemonic: You are late, so you cut straight across the lawn to your department (科) right now (今) instead of following the square paths. Diagonal (slanting, oblique).

k:隔.mnemonic: The cook with a cold is sent over the mound (阝) with his own cauldron (鬲), so that he does not eat from the same (同) pot as everyone else. Isolate (alternate, distance, separate).
k:隔.hint: Sniffling cook sent over the hill.

k:鶏.mnemonic: A big (大) bird (鳥) that follows a person (人) around the yard, scratching at the soil (土) with one claw (爪) for dropped grain. Chicken.

k:澄.mnemonic: Ascend (登) above the valley the tsunami (氵) churned to brown, and the mountain pool is so still that you can count the pebbles on the bottom. Lucidity (be clear, clear, clarify).
k:澄.hint: Counting pebbles in a high pool.

k:懲.mnemonic: The judge reads out the indications (徴) of guilt one by one, and the heart (心) underneath sinks: a sentence is coming. Penal (chastise, punish, discipline).

k:郊.mnemonic: The edge where the borough (阝) starts to mingle (交) with farmland: a house, then cabbages, then a house again. Outskirts (suburbs, rural area).

k:扉.mnemonic: A notice about an injustice (非) is nailed to a door (戸) where every passer-by will read it, so it has to be the one facing the street. Front door (title page, front page).

k:妖.mnemonic: A woman (女) with a big (大) tilt of the head and a look that stops travellers in the road. In the old stories she is usually a fox. Attractive (bewitching, calamity).

k:艇.mnemonic: The king (王) takes one long stride (廴) off the dock into a little boat (舟), and finds he has to work the oars himself. Rowboat (small boat).

k:銘.mnemonic: A name (名) cut into gold (金). The maker signs the work in letters that will never rub off. Inscription (signature of artisan).

k:鎌.mnemonic: The master (主) of the harvest swings a curved edge that flashes like gold (金), and the cut stalks are gathered behind him with a broom (ヨ). Sickle (scythe, trick).

k:陳.mnemonic: On the mound (阝) at the east (東) end of town, the goods are laid out in rows where the morning sun shows them off best. Exhibit (state, relate, explain).
k:陳.hint: Goods laid out in morning sun.

k:硬.mnemonic: Wet clay left out as the hours grow late (更) is like stone (石) by morning: you cannot press a thumb into it. Stiff (hard).
